name: Wim Hof Breathing Method
summary: Controlled hyperventilation followed by breath retention for stress resilience and focus

actions.name: Wim Hof breathing (15-20 min)
actions.description: 3 rounds of: 30-40 deep breaths (in through nose, out through mouth) → exhale and hold until urge to breathe → deep breath in, hold 15 seconds → exhale. Do on empty stomach, never in water or driving.

actions.name: Cold shower finish (30-60 sec)
actions.description: End shower with cold water. Start with 30 seconds, build to 2 minutes over weeks. Focus on breathing through the discomfort.

warnings: Never do near water (drowning risk during breath hold)
Consult doctor if you have heart conditions
notes: The breathing creates temporary alkalosis and may cause tingling, lightheadedness. This is normal. Start with 2 rounds if 3 feels intense.
